How Client-Side BPM & Key Detection Works

Traditional online tempo checkers require sending your private audio files to remote cloud servers. PrivKnife processes everything directly in your browser using the Web Audio API:

Zero Uploads: Audio buffers are decoded entirely in local device memory using AudioContext.decodeAudioData().
Percussion Isolation: An IIR low-pass filter (cutoff ≤ 150 Hz) extracts kick drums and bass transients.
Onset Autocorrelation: Periodicity analysis determines dominant beat intervals with harmonic ambiguity checks.
Krumhansl-Schmuckler Key Finding: 12-class chromagram profile correlation maps notes to both traditional keys and the Camelot Wheel for seamless DJ harmonic mixing.

How Client-Side BPM & Key Detection Works

Traditional online tempo checkers require sending your private audio files to remote cloud servers. PrivKnife processes everything directly in your browser using the Web Audio API:

Zero Uploads: Audio buffers are decoded entirely in local device memory using AudioContext.decodeAudioData().
Percussion Isolation: An IIR low-pass filter (cutoff ≤ 150 Hz) extracts kick drums and bass transients.
Onset Autocorrelation: Periodicity analysis determines dominant beat intervals with harmonic ambiguity checks.
Krumhansl-Schmuckler Key Finding: 12-class chromagram profile correlation maps notes to both traditional keys and the Camelot Wheel for seamless DJ harmonic mixing.

Orientation: Print standing vertically (on edge) along the Y-axis for maximum photorealistic resolution.
Infill: Use 100% infill (rectilinear). Any hollow or low-density pattern will create grid artifacts when backlit.
Layer Height: Set to 0.12mm (fine) or 0.16mm for crisp optical depth and smooth gradient transitions.
Filament: Pure White or Warm White PLA yields the highest optical contrast and luminosity.
Brim / Adhesion: Use a 5mm outer brim to prevent tall lithophanes from wobbling or detaching during rapid printing.

How Client-Side BPM & Key Detection Works

Traditional online tempo checkers require sending your private audio files to remote cloud servers. PrivKnife processes everything directly in your browser using the Web Audio API:

Zero Uploads: Audio buffers are decoded entirely in local device memory using AudioContext.decodeAudioData().
Percussion Isolation: An IIR low-pass filter (cutoff ≤ 150 Hz) extracts kick drums and bass transients.
Onset Autocorrelation: Periodicity analysis determines dominant beat intervals with harmonic ambiguity checks.
Krumhansl-Schmuckler Key Finding: 12-class chromagram profile correlation maps notes to both traditional keys and the Camelot Wheel for seamless DJ harmonic mixing.
